module purpose: Package that defines constants, memory and I/O base addresses, CSR and exception/IRQ constants, record and type declarations, helper functions, and the neorv32_top component interface (generics and ports). It supplies only static configuration, types and utility functions and declares the top-level component's interface; this file contains no entity implementation, no sequential logic, and therefore implements no runtime flows (see examples: hw_version_c at line 32; mem_io_base_c at line 53; base_io_* at lines 71-92; CSR constants cluster at lines 376-412 and many others; neorv32_top component declaration at lines 789-895 and its port list at 897-977; helper function declarations at 764-783 and bodies at 990-1256).
